about: High / Critical npm advisories the Security workflow accepts for now because no safe (patch / minor) upgrade fixes them. Each entry names the exact advisories, why, and a review-by date — after `until` the workflow fails again. Read by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Remove an entry as soon as its fix lands.

entries.reason: Fixed only in Next 16 — a major upgrade from 14 (React 19, App Router changes), its own project. Most need features the dashboard doesn't use (Server Actions, middleware, the i18n Pages Router, rewrites, WebSocket upgrades, a configured image optimizer — no remote patterns, no AVIF —, Windows hosting); the Server Components denial-of-service ones apply to any App Router app until the upgrade. Upgrade Next to clear these.
The copy nested inside next@14 (node_modules/next/node_modules/postcss) — only Next 16 updates it. It runs at build time on the repository's own CSS, never on user input.

Pulled in by onnxruntime-node under @livekit/agents-plugin-silero; the fix is a major upgrade of the LiveKit plugins, which must move together (all @livekit/agents* pinned to one version — CLAUDE.md). The worker only unzips the model files its own packages ship, never an uploaded archive.
No fixed sharp release for @livekit/agents' range yet (librsvg CVE). The voice worker never decodes SVG or other images from callers.
